main.name: freiheit.com
main.when: April 2020 to December 2023 · Full Stack Software Engineer
main.summary: Nearly four years building client products at freiheit.com, from mobile apps to back offices, and my first time leading a team.

items: A companion app for electric vehicles, for Germany's largest car manufacturer. Flutter.
A video on demand and networking app. Flutter.
An omnichannel e-commerce platform for Germany's third-largest fashion retailer. Vue.js in front, Go and Kotlin behind.
A contract management back office for the world's fourth-largest retailer.
Started leading: six engineers on the contract management back office.
Picked up Kubernetes, MongoDB, MySQL and CI/CD pipelines along the way.
